q: Which keyword declares a block-scoped variable that can be reassigned?
e: let is block-scoped and reassignable. const is block-scoped but cannot be reassigned.

q: Which method adds an item to the end of an array?
e: push() appends to the end and returns the new length.

q: Which array method returns a new array of items that pass a test?
e: filter() keeps only the items for which the callback returns true.

q: Which function parses JSON text into an object?
e: JSON.parse() turns a JSON string into a JavaScript value.
